meta.title: A negative quantity in the vendor's quantity column is refused

steps.note: Create the RFQ event used to reach the vendor bidding sheet.
Use an RFQ pricing stage for the vendor quantity test.
Apply a pricing template before adding line items.
Add one requested product for the vendor to quote.
Complete the buyer-side pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Invite the QA vendor whose portal will be tested.
Publish the event so the vendor can access its bid sheet.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal.
Open the event's vendor pricing sheet.
Enter the invalid negative offered quantity specified by the case.
Verify the vendor sheet refuses -1 rather than keeping or accepting it.
